itemdesc-gear-quarter: Worth 0.25 rusty gear at a Banker. Four quarters craft into one whole rusty gear.
bank-welcome: Welcome. The Bank shall attend to your account.
bank-ready: How may the Bank be of service?
bank-timeout: No reply yet. Retry the request or close this window.
bank-uncertain: The transaction outcome is not yet known. Retry checks the same request; it does not submit another transaction.
bank-check-history: The outcome may be uncertain. Reopen the ledger and check history before attempting this transaction again.
bank-bad-reply: The Bank's reply could not be read. An outstanding transaction has not been assumed to fail.
bank-committed: The Bank has confirmed the transaction.
bank-no-statement: No current statement is available. Refresh to request one. If you have no account yet, a first deposit or incoming transfer opens it.
bank-rounding: Rounded displays do not discard any remainder. Physical withdrawals must be exactly representable in accepted gears.
bank-cash-help: Use your own hotbar and backpack. Rusty cash uses whole gears and quarters; temporal cash uses whole gears. Enter a decimal point, without grouping separators. The Bank will review the exact amount before confirmation.
bank-transfer-help: Transfers move rusty savings only. Resolve the recipient and review the Bank's confirmation before sending.
bank-all-at-commit: entire balance; exact amount determined at commit
bank-cash-recheck: The Bank will check funds and inventory again at commit. Nothing is reserved by this preview, and no partial amount will be moved.
bank-irreversible: This transfer is immediate and final. There is no fee, cancellation, or partial transfer.
bank-cd-help: New CD principal in rusty gears (minimum at opening: {0}). Current contract values below are informational and cannot be spent.
bank-cd-values: Principal {0} • informational value {1} • maturity {2} rusty gears
bank-projected-maturity: Projected calendar maturity: {0} (may change if the calendar is reanchored)
bank-runtime-maturity: Maturity follows active server runtime, not an in-world calendar date.
bank-confirm-cd:
Purchase a CD for exactly {0} rusty gears?
Term: {1} financial months from purchase
Exact maturity payoff: {2} rusty gears
bank-quote-components:
Annual continuous components:
Risk-free {0}; base spread {1}; level {2}; slope {3}; liquidity {4}
bank-cd-lockup: The principal is locked until maturity. There is no early redemption. The offer expires after 30 real seconds; the Bank rechecks expiry at commit.
bank-notice-history: Individual details are retained in your history.
bank-error-InvalidAmount: Enter a positive amount using the permitted decimal precision.
bank-error-InvalidCurrency: That currency is not supported for this operation.
bank-error-InsufficientFunds: The account has insufficient funds. No partial transaction was made.
bank-error-BalanceCap: This transaction would exceed an account's balance cap.
bank-error-ArithmeticFault: The Bank could not represent this financial operation safely.
bank-error-InvalidTime: The Bank's financial clock is unavailable.
bank-error-NoAccount: No account exists yet. A first deposit or incoming transfer opens one.
bank-error-UnknownRecipient: That recipient is not known in this world's current name registry.
bank-error-AmbiguousRecipient: That name is ambiguous. The Bank cannot safely identify one recipient.
bank-error-RecipientServiceUnavailable: The recipient directory is unavailable. Other banking services may still be used.
bank-error-SelfTransfer: You cannot transfer savings to yourself.
bank-error-InvalidSession: This Banker conversation is no longer available. Close the ledger and speak to a Banker again.
bank-error-InvalidSequence: The request sequence is no longer valid. Reopen the ledger before continuing.
bank-error-PayloadMismatch: The request does not match its earlier submission. Reopen the ledger and check history.
bank-error-AlreadyProcessedResponseExpir: This request was already processed, but its reply has expired. Check history; do not submit it again.
bank-error-ExpiredConfirmation: The offer or recipient confirmation expired or changed. Request a fresh review.
bank-error-Cooldown: Please wait briefly before making another transfer.
bank-error-InvalidDenomination: The exact amount cannot be represented in the accepted physical gear denominations.
bank-error-InventoryUnavailable: The required gears are unavailable, or your inventory cannot accept the complete withdrawal.
bank-error-SettlementQuarantined: Banking is held for recovery review. Contact a server administrator; no repair has been guessed.
bank-error-PermissionDenied: This operation is not available under the server's settings or your permissions.
bank-error-InvalidConfiguration: The Bank's configuration is invalid. Contact a server administrator.
bank-error-CorruptState: The Bank's saved authority is unavailable. Contact a server administrator.
bank-error-InvalidRequest: The Bank could not accept this request. Check the entered values.
bank-error-ServiceUnavailable: The banking service is unavailable. Contact a server administrator if this persists.
bank-error-Suspended: The server is paused. Banking will resume with the world.
bank-error-ResponseTooLarge: The requested display is too large. Request a smaller page.
bank-error-Starting: The Bank is still opening. Please try again shortly.
